Our platform streamlines the entire catering workflow, making ordering faster, more affordable and more reliable than traditional options. By combining diverse cuisine partners, real-time logistics and automation tools for restaurants, we're transforming how catering gets done. We value strong relationships with our team, our customers and our restaurant partners. We foster a collaborative, people-first culture where you can grow your skills, build meaningful technology and make a real impact within a fast-scaling startup. About the Role As a Software Developer at CaterDash, you'll help build and evolve the technology that powers our marketplace. You'll work on customer-facing features, restaurant partner tools, operational systems, analytics dashboards and automation initiatives. You'll also leverage modern AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality and support internal efficiencies. This role is ideal for developers who love solving real-world problems, enjoy startup ownership, and want to work across a broad technical stack. We are hiring for (1) full-time and (1) co-op/intern positions based in Vancouver, with hybrid or remote flexibility. Responsibilities Platform Development • Build and improve features across web services, ordering experiences, partner dashboards and internal tools. • Translate user and business needs into intuitive, high-quality technical solutions. Write clean, scalable, well-tested code across front-end and back-end components. • Systems & Infrastructure • Integrate with external APIs for payments, logistics, data analytics and restaurant management systems. • Support improvements in system performance, scalability and security. Contribute to dev-ops practices including CI/CD, automation and monitoring. • AI-Enhanced Development & Automation • Use AI tools to support ideation, prototyping, debugging and documentation. • Identify opportunities to automate internal workflows using AI or scripting tools. Collaborate with teams to build lightweight AI-powered utilities that streamline operations or improve customer experience. • Product Iteration • Participate in design and architectural discussions. Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize feature performance. Gather insights from cross-functional teams to inform iterative improvements. • • Collaboration & Documentation • Work closely with operations, sales and marketing teams to understand workflow pain points. Document system behavior, APIs, architecture decisions and feature specs clearly. • Why CaterDash? • Build meaningful product features with immediate real-world impact. • Learn from and collaborate with experienced engineers and leaders. • Exposure to full-stack development, product strategy and technical decision-making in a fast-growing startup. • Flexibility for hybrid/remote work. • A passionate, innovative team rethinking how catering works across North America. The expected salary range for this role is $40,000 - $50,000 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands and internal pay parity. Learn more about us: www.caterdash.com Job Requirements Education and Experience • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline. • 1-3 years of hands-on software development experience (startup/marketplace experience is an advantage). • Proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js, React, SQL/NoSQL databases. • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to enhance workflow. • Strong debugging, problem-solving and architectural thinking. • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP is a plus. Qualities We Value • Curiosity and eagerness to learn new technologies. • Strong communication and collaboration skills. • Ability to thrive in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
